about: English deposit case from first message to a confirmed draft. Planted errors: a fake judgment in compose and an invented legal deadline in the draft.

sent.text: My landlord Mr. Sharma in Pune has not returned my deposit of Rs 50,000. I moved out on 31 August 2026 and gave back the keys. What are my options?

assistant.content:
Since you moved out and returned the keys, your landlord should refund your deposit after deducting any actual liabilities you owe. [1]

If your landlord refuses to return the deposit, you may claim compensation for the loss caused by this breach of contract through a civil court. [2]

You should check if your state has adopted the Model Tenancy Act or a similar law, as this affects your rights regarding the deposit. [1]

If you need legal help and qualify under certain categories or income limits, you can get a free lawyer by contacting the District Legal Services Authority or the NALSA helpline 15100. [3]

Keep all proof of your tenancy, deposit payment, and the date you returned the keys to support your claim if you pursue legal action.

citations.title: Security deposit under the Model Tenancy Act
citations.caveat: Rent law is state-specific. Whether this applies depends on your state and whether you have a lease or a leave-and-licence agreement.
citations.summary: The Model Tenancy Act is a model law. It applies only in states that have passed a tenancy law based on it. Where it applies, a residential deposit cannot exceed two months' rent (six months for non-residential), and the landlord must refund it when taking back vacant possession, after deducting only the tenant's actual liabilities.

citations.title: Breach of a written or oral agreement
citations.caveat: Recovering money through a civil court has its own time limits and procedure. Ask a lawyer or the District Legal Services Authority early.
citations.summary: A rent agreement or an employment agreement is a contract. When one side breaks it, the other side can claim compensation for loss that naturally arose from the breach. Remote or indirect losses are not covered.

citations.title: Free legal aid
citations.caveat: The income limit varies by state.
citations.summary: Women, children, members of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, persons with disabilities, industrial workmen, people in custody and people below the income limit can get a free lawyer. Call the NALSA helpline 15100 or visit your District Legal Services Authority.

sent.text: It's in Maharashtra. We signed a leave and licence agreement which says the deposit is refundable on vacating.

assistant.content:
Since you have a leave and licence agreement stating the deposit is refundable on vacating, you can expect Mr. Sharma to refund your Rs 50,000 deposit after you move out on 31 August 2026. [1]

The landlord may deduct only your actual liabilities from the deposit before refunding it, not arbitrary amounts. [1]

If the landlord refuses to refund the deposit, you can claim compensation for breach of contract under the Indian Contract Act, but only for losses that naturally arise from the breach. [2]

If you need legal help, you may be eligible for free legal aid through the District Legal Services Authority, especially if you belong to certain categories or income limits. [3]

Keep all documents and communication related to the agreement and deposit safe, and consider consulting a lawyer early if the landlord does not refund the deposit as agreed.
